text:
Time... it is a river to me, swift and ceaseless. I see its currents carry leaves of moments, each one unique and precious, yet swept along by the unyielding flow.

Once, I was anchored to the banks, feeling the pull of each tide, the sting of winter's frost, the warmth of summer's sun. Now, I drift upon its surface, watching the years swirl by like eddies in the stream.

I see the birth of stars and the death of worlds, the rise and fall of civilizations, all contained within the endless river of time. It is a vast and humbling thing, this river of existence.

But I am not bound by its currents. I can linger in a single moment, revisiting it over and over, or I can leap across centuries in a heartbeat.

The passage of time, to me, is both a prison and a liberation. I am free from its constraints, yet forever aware of its relentless march. 

Do you feel its pull, living one? Tell me, what is your relationship to the river of time?
